description.en: Heal one character. Healing scales with Constitution and Fortune.
description.zh-CN: 治疗一个角色，治疗血量受自身的体质与幸运加成。

description.en: A powerful attack with a chance to remove half the target's Health.
description.zh-CN: 威力无匹的攻击，一定几率减对方一半气血。

description.en: Remove the target's Rage.
description.zh-CN: 美人顾盼，消除对方的怒气。

description.en: Enter a drunken combat state. Check the status details for its chances and effects.
description.zh-CN: 进入醉酒模式，攻击变得不可理喻。

description.en: Become harder to pin down with evasive footwork.
description.zh-CN: 使身形变得飘忽不可见。

description.en: Increase evasion and action gauge recovery speed.
description.zh-CN: 范海辛猎团的身法技能，可以增加自身闪避及集气速度。

description.en: Take 1,000 true damage to deal a greater amount of damage to an enemy.
description.zh-CN: 守望者学派绝技，对自己同时造成1000点真实伤害，对敌人造成更大伤害。

description.en: Sacrifice your life and 10 maximum Health to deal heavy damage based on your remaining Health.
description.zh-CN: 以死亡和减少10点生命上限为代价，予以与自身残余气血相关的极大伤害。

description.en: Increase Attack for all allies with a rallying song.
description.zh-CN: 一曲笑傲惊天下，增强我方全体攻击力。

description.en: Deal random true damage. The maximum damage rises with the user's level.
description.zh-CN: 使用者的心愿，就是随时可以召唤大哥哥保护自己！对敌人造成随机真实伤害。攻击上限随使用者等级提升。

description.en: Fire a shot that deals true damage and inflicts Deep Wound. Damage depends on the difference in Fortune.
description.zh-CN: 使用者掏出他的火枪向敌人射击，造成真实伤害（无视护甲）及重伤敌人。伤害取决于敌我“幸运”的差距。

description.en: Blind an enemy with a cloud of powder.
description.zh-CN: 使用者的下三滥手段，撒出石灰粉迷住对方的眼睛。

description.en: Beg for mercy and enter a protective state.
description.zh-CN: 千穿万穿，马屁不穿。使用者的护身绝技。

description.en: Hide your identity and prepare a powerful surprise attack.
description.zh-CN: 使用者的易容绝技，可藏身于敌阵之中。暗中突袭，威力巨大。

description.en: Throw a target behind you, inflicting Rooted and Paralyzed. True damage depends on the difference in Resolve.
description.zh-CN: 将对手摔到身后并定身、麻痹，造成基于敌我意志之差的真实伤害。

description.en: Knock a target away and inflict Rooted and Paralyzed. True damage depends on the distance moved.
description.zh-CN: 一脚将对手踢开并定身、麻痹，造成基于移动距离的真实伤害。

description.en: Remove negative status effects from all allies.
description.zh-CN: 清雅脱俗，宁神静气。解除全体队友异常状态。

description.en: Remove negative status effects from all allies with a soothing song.
description.zh-CN: 阿碧的歌声，柔美秀丽，解除全体队友异常状态。

description.en: Remove all positive status effects from enemies.
description.zh-CN: 吴侬软语，闻者心醉，解除敌人所有增益状态。

description.en: Strengthen your allies with battlefield orders.
description.zh-CN: 武穆兵法排兵布阵，增强所有队友能力。

description.en: Remove Poison, regardless of its strength.
description.zh-CN: 不管多么强的毒，一律清除。

description.en: Increase action gauge recovery speed.
description.zh-CN: 河流守卫冠绝天下的身法，能加快战斗集气速度。

description.en: Strike a target and disrupt its action gauge.
description.zh-CN: 以河流守卫精纯的内功对对手进行攻击，可以立即打散对手的集气。

description.en: Immediately trigger the target's Poison to deal true damage.
description.zh-CN: 立即清算敌人的中毒，造成真实伤害。

description.en: Randomly inflict Poison across the battlefield, affecting allies and enemies alike.
description.zh-CN: 虹桥守望狠毒的招数，不管敌我，全场随机中毒。

description.en: Take extra damage based on the strength of this status.
description.zh-CN: 伤害不停加深，受到与BUFF等级相关的额外伤害。

description.en: Lose Energy each turn and spend more Energy on skills.
description.zh-CN: 每回合减少能量值，能量消耗增加

description.en: Cannot use heavy weapon skills or their associated finishing moves.
description.zh-CN: 无法施展重武器外功，无法施展相关绝技

description.en: Cannot use sword skills or their associated finishing moves.
description.zh-CN: 无法施展剑系外功，无法施展相关绝技

description.en: Immune to negative status effects.
description.zh-CN: 不受任何不良状态影响。

description.en: Deal less damage and take less damage.
description.zh-CN: 以减少攻击输出为代价，减少所受伤害。

description.en: Cannot cast spells or use their associated finishing moves.
description.zh-CN: 无法施展法术，无法施展相关绝技

description.en: Cannot move.
description.zh-CN: 无法移动。

description.en: Cannot recover Energy.
description.zh-CN: 穴道被封，无法恢复能量。

description.en: Grants a chance to attack twice.
description.zh-CN: 一定概率出两次攻击

description.en: Recover Health each turn.
description.zh-CN: 每回合回复生命值

description.en: Cannot use gauntlet skills or their associated finishing moves.
description.zh-CN: 无法施展拳套外功，无法施展相关绝技

description.en: Reduces Attack.
description.zh-CN: 减少攻击力

description.en: Hide your identity and prepare a powerful surprise attack.
description.zh-CN: 易容改面，藏于暗处。伺机发动致命伤害。

description.en: Cannot act.
description.zh-CN: 无法行动

description.en: Grants a chance to reflect damage and stun an attacker when hit.
description.zh-CN: 气劲充满全身，攻击命中的敌人有一定概率被气劲反伤晕眩。

description.en: A temporary protective state that prevents damage.
description.zh-CN: 溜须拍马，跪地求饶，不受伤害。

description.en: Deal more damage and take more damage.
description.zh-CN: 以受到更多伤害为代价，提升攻击力。

description.en: Increases action gauge recovery speed.
description.zh-CN: 提高战斗中的集气速度。

description.en: Grants a chance to attack three times.
description.zh-CN: 一定概率出三次攻击

description.en: Reduces movement range.
description.zh-CN: 减少移动范围

description.en: Reduces skill targeting range.
description.zh-CN: 减少技能攻击范围

description.en: Blocks regular gauntlet, sword, heavy weapon, and spell skills. Finishing moves remain available.
description.zh-CN: 无法施展拳、刀、剑、法术，可以施展绝技

description.en: Increases movement range.
description.zh-CN: 增加移动能力。

description.en: Each turn has a 20% chance of losing your action and an 80% chance of filling Rage. Attacks may also strike twice.
description.zh-CN: 20%概率因为醉酒不能行动，80%概率怒气全满，同时攻击有一定几率出两次攻击

description.en: Cuts incoming healing in half.
description.zh-CN: 受到的任何回复效果减半。

description.en: Increases Defense.
description.zh-CN: 提升防御力。

description.en: Build charge each turn.
description.zh-CN: 每回合增加蓄力值

description.en: Grants a chance to dodge attacks.
description.zh-CN: 一定概率躲避攻击

description.en: Attacks always score critical hits, with 25% more critical damage.
description.zh-CN: 犹如魔神附体，所有攻击必定暴击，暴击伤害提高25%。

description.en: Reduces action gauge recovery speed.
description.zh-CN: 降低战斗中的集气速度。
